I could send in which characters I have, but I think its easier to say which I don't have: GDoll, GMurphy, Pontos, Sorel, Doresain, Pickman, Xu, Daffodil, Clementine, Castor, Pollux and Arachne. BUT, no Character is on OE, besides of Lotan, so characters which NEED OE, are also a bit problematic.

So yeah.. I am not lacking characters.
The question is rather: what to build with them? Normally for this I would go to a website which has builds to get some ideas and then put my own spins on that, but either I am stupid (honestly, not unlikely) or there are not really ressources for "which characters synagize with each other". At least non which can be found with search engines. (Maybe somewhere deeply hidden in some discord.. but yeah.. discord is not exactly known for discoverability - why half the gaming world has their knowledge base in discord now, is beyond me)

What I am currently thinking and would like some feedback on (I haven't build most of these team cause of limited resources; kinda don't want to build teams which don't work in the end - only teams 1 and 2 are build):

1. Lotan OE team
This is what I used as a main team basically since I started this game, and this served me really well - and Lotan OE will 100% be one of the Teams I want to use  
Lotan (duh), Horla (Passive Alimens gen), Lily (Defense), Winkel (Battery)  
But in this team, I have recently struggled a bit with Alimens gen, so... a Keyflare bot would probably be an idea? And then monochaos? GDoll isn't available for me.. so which other Keyflare Chaos Bots exist? And then I also want to swap Winkel for a Chaos Battery... or I forget about this, and just swap Lily for a Keyflare bot, maybe Erica?

2. GLotan Team
This is the one I use for Maps/Missions, Lotan isn't able to handle because of 10 Billion boss phases (like the tree boss) or because she struggles too much with the small encounters (like 9-12)
GLotan (duh again), Saya (Corrosion and Card Duplication), Ramona (Card search), Hameln (Card draw and Rondino/Crescendo)
Maybe swap Saya for something else, because she feels extremely powerful and would probably be good for another team, which struggles more with Damage

3. Vortice
I like nuclear bombs. Vortice is a living Nucelar Bomb
Maybe Vortice, Murphy, Celeste, Tawli? Saya would probably be also good here if I pull her out of GLotans Team

4. Not very safe for work
Something I really want to try is a Tentacle Damage Team with ~~best boy~~ Tulu. Maybe together with Corposant (?). But I have absolutely no idea what else might be worthwhile in this team.

And for the last team I have no general plan. I heard there are some Karen + Tiwil shenanigans with go infinite? That might be something to play around with. But other than that this will probably be a "Borrow a whale hypercarry Muchette" team and I will build a proper Team for slot 5 later(tm)
